snippet.title: Krampus Of Kirkwall (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Play Here:
https://lunareffectdigital.itch.io/krampus-of-kirkwall


Small Christmas horror narrative game, made in a month!

A much needed remake of "I Caught Santa claus"
Though it's not perfect, it's much better than the original. All future games are going to strive for high quality gameplay, so stay tuned!
